reviews.comment: Dr. Johnson is retiring, but I just wanted to say how awesome her class was. I think she was an amazing, caring prof who had so many experiences in the field. She was so funny and her class was easy if you read and study her powerpoints! Your grade reflects the time you put in. Lab is terrible, but it helps you remember everything better. Love 112!

Loved her. Very sad she's retiring. This class is hard no matter what, but Dr. Johnson made going to class enjoyable and the subject matter interesting. Tests were straight off the slides, but go to class because she explains the material so much more than just what's on them.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Carol is HILARIOUS, there is no lie about that. BUT, her tests are impossible. No matter how hard you study, you'll end up a C in the test. You are lucky, she is retiring. Thank god.

When a teacher begins the first lecture with a pokemon example you know she's good. I hardly went to class, just read the textbook and her powerpoints. She is really nice and her tests are fair. Take her she is the best!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She doesn't do research, and this shows in how much she seems to genuinely love teaching.

Dr. Johnson is pretty good option for BIOL 112. She's a good lecturer and she's a pretty nice lady. The exams are a little frustrating though, because sometimes there is material on the exam that she didn't cover in lecture but was (apparently) in the study guide she provides. Attendance isn't mandatory, but bonus points are available if you do.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: All of the test material comes from the powerpoints she goes over in lecture, she posts these online but i would definitely recommend going to class to get additional info and to better understand the material. The hardest part of this class is the lab be prepared to have to study for lab every week ( the material is alot harder than 111).
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I hated this prof. Don't even read the book. The tests are all straight off her slides which are blank so you have to show up to write them in. Her tests are extremely confusing. If you suck at lab you'll suck at her tests because she asks a lot of lab questions on her tests. Did good on the first two tests but the last two were very hard. Sucks.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: JOHNSON IS THE BEST. Easiest bio class ever. She makes the class interesting and knows what she's talking about. LAB is very hard so beware.

BIOL 112 is a very hard class, especially the lab, but i feel like Dr. Johnson does a good job of portraying the information. I liked that her powerpoint slides were short and straight to the point. I have made high C's on each of our 3 exams so its pretty difficult but johnson is really nice. If you ever need help she is super nice in her office!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Tests are impossible even if you study. Purposely tries to trick you on multiple choice. Does not curve even if the class has a bad average. Lots of reading. If you don't read the textbook won't make higher than a C. Lab is very difficult too, make sure you study a lot for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's alright. She obviously loves what she's teaching. Bonus questions in class. Fill in the blank notes. Hard tests. I studied for days and still wouldn't do very well. Her review are extremely long. No homework. No quizzes. No curve. There is so so so much to know. TA helpful.

Take Johnson for 112. Lab is next to impossible but its only 1/4 of your grade. I absolutely bombed the lab practicals but lecture isn't as hard. If you are used to reading your textbook for bio 111, then you'll do fine. Gives lecture bonus 1 question quizzes throughout the semester. Quirky prof that loves her job.

Dr. Johnson was a great prof! Go to lecture, fill out her power point slides, and study those for the test. The book is helpful but unnecessary as exams came from her slides. She is very passionate about biology and gives extra credit pop quizzes so go to class. She is a very understanding professor if she knows students are putting in effort.

Carol is very knowledgeable and is willing to answer questions to make things more clear. The class itself is very information heavy, would not take if you don't have to. She gives in class quizzes for extra credit sometimes, so show up! Going to her office helps too (she remembers who does when she's finalizing grades). Sweet lady

I was really excited to take BIO 112 with Dr. Johnson, but I am extremely disappointed. There's so much information to learn for this class, and while I understand that's not the prof's fault, Dr. Johnson certainly didn't make it any easier. I studied DAYS in advance for hours and hours and I still didn't do very well. Overall, take another prof.

She was a pretty good prof. Biology 112 doesnt cover a lot of hard material but her tests are a little tricky so be careful. She brings a lot of helpful visuals in lecture & provides some funny little comments to help you remember something. She gives bonus quizzes so go to lecture & provides REALLY helpful study guides so do all of them!

Dr. Johnson is a great professor.  Her lectures are very clear and interesting.  Her tests are not too bad.  Read the book and take good notes and you should be fine.  I really enjoyed this class.  She also gives lots of bonus quizzes throughout the semester, they are easy but you have to be in class to get the points.  I would take her again.

She's a really great teacher and you can tell that she loves what she does, but this is not an easy class. Lectures are clear and precise, but the textbook is needed if you want to make above a C. Lab was probably the hardest part (depends on your TA), but I would definitely take Dr. Johnson again.

She's an AMAZING prof.  She provides notes with holes missing online so you have to come to class but its easy to get all the notes. You definitely should read the text book. She also posts study plans online so that you can see what she thinks is important

Dr Johnson was amazing! She made lectures fun and included real world examples of the concepts being learned. Biol 112 is not an easy class, but with Dr. Johnson it was a little bit easier. definitely recomend

When she teaches, it is very clear that she loves biology. She was pretty funny in class. She has three non-cumulative exams with a cumulative final. Her exams weren't too tough. Go to class, read the textbook, and review her notes before each exam. Make sure you understand everything. She posts practice exams on eCampus. Make sure you do those.

Dr. Johnson was very helpful in office hours (and wrote down my name when I visited her so she takes note of that) and had very clear, concise lectures. I advise going to SI because her tests required reasoning and not just regurgitation. About 8, random, one-question quizzes (not hard) per semester.

Johnson's class is hard, but it is possible to make an A. She posts fill in the blank notes that are SO helpful. She also follows the book. Some of her test questions were very similar to practice questions from the book and from the mastering bio site that you get when you buy the book! She also gives tons of easy bonus point quizzes in class.
The tests are pretty hard, but she's a very nice prof.

Dr. Johnson is one of the easiest BIOL112 professors you can have. Don't get me wrong, the class is still very difficult due to the large amount of details you need to know about all of the phylums and classes, but if you go to A+ and study the notes an A in the class is more than possible. I would take her again for sure!
BORING!! Her tests are hard. They are worderd weird. If you were hoping to use MasteringBiology don't bother, it's not going to help. She has extra credit opportunities but they don't help much.

The class was fairly interesting, and Dr. Johnson is very knowledgeable and passionate about what she teaches.  The lectures were well-organized and easy to follow, though there is a lot of information to learn and the tests are difficult if you do not study a lot.
I absolutely love Dr. Johnson! She is one of the greatest profs I've had at A&M. DEFINITELY would recommend her. If she taught another class, I would sign up in a heartbeat.

Wish someone had warned me so unless you have to, don't take her. Questions on tests are worded so weird. Class is boring, gives a few extra bonus points if you go to class but overall doesn't help too much. Not very helpful when you go talk to her, just tells you to study your notes (duh) a lot of people in my class have been complaining about her

There is so much information. Memorize it Daily and you will ace her class. Lab sucks because you have to learn the lecture material a week or two earlier. But again, MEMORIZE VERBATIM. and you will get an A. I got a B because I waited until the last 2 days to study for the exam

She is a pretty good proff. She goes directly off of her powerpoints. Read the cooresponding chapters cuz it helps. She appreciates questions and her tests are moderatly hot. Again read the book because there will be test questions from it. She does offer some extra credit but you have to work for it. SI is extreamly helpful!!!

Dr. Johnson's lectures are not always the most interesting, but she knows her lectures very well and appreciates questions! There is a lot of material covered in this class that is very difficult to comprehend, but study the processes like what is used and made! Her tests are fairly hard, yet not very consistent... Overall, pretty good prof!
Must read the book, go to class, and do all the extra work to get a good grade.  Lots of tricky questions on the tests.
Go to class and do all suggested work
class notes boring, tests are HARD!! you have to study ALOT!!!!!! very boring!!!
